weather_utility_ruling.retained: behavioural and mechanical evidence stands: the Agent inspected named scoped series, the Runtime compiled and executed Typed Programs, Episodes and Target-local Skills formed, attribution and the Slow single-surface route ran, and the paired replay changed next-round behaviour
weather_utility_ruling.unavailable: every aggregate utility conclusion on Weather, positive or negative, is UNAVAILABLE / METRIC_UNREADABLE
weather_utility_ruling.reason: macro_gain is an unweighted mean over eval channels whose identity losses span 24.4x. Three solar-radiation channels the forecaster cannot predict at all (sMASE about 17, where 1.0 is seasonal-naive parity) carry the aggregate, while the two channels it does forecast well both get worse under the same Program. T233 spans 2.0x and reads cleanly, so this is a property of the Weather cohort, not of the Judge in general.
